description: This PHP source file is part of the TestLink open-source test management project. It contains code for managing test plans, including creating, retrieving, and linking test cases within a test plan. The script initializes objects like testplan, testproject, and build manager, and performs various operations such as fetching linked test case versions, creating test projects, and executing test plan related actions.

classes.name: testproject
classes.description: Class for managing test projects, including creation, retrieval by name, and deletion.

classes.name: testplan
classes.description: Class for managing test plans, including creation, fetching by ID or name, and getting related test case versions and builds.

classes.name: build_mgr
classes.description: Class for managing test plan builds, including creation and retrieval by ID.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Creates a new entity (test project, test plan, or build) with specified parameters.

methods.name: get_by_name
methods.description: Retrieves information about a test project by its name.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Deletes an entity such as a test project or build by its ID.

methods.name: get_by_id
methods.description: Fetches details of an entity (test plan or build) by its ID.

methods.name: get_linked_tcversions
methods.description: Retrieves linked test case versions for a specific test plan.
